candidates.suggested_collection_method: Periodic dataset resource download + delta load into local store; keyword/CPV filter for banking, payments, cards, ATM, cash handling.
queries_used: statistika javnega naročanja portal odprti podatki OPSI "javna naročila" evidenčna naročila dataset

candidates.source_name: OPSI dataset – Zbirka objavljenih odločitev o oddaji javnega naročila
candidates.why_relevant: Award decisions ('odločitve o oddaji') with portal publication number, TED number and contracting-authority data — the join key between the national portal, TED and the contract register. Award decisions frequently name the selected bidder before the formal award notice appears.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scheduled resource download; use the TED publication number field to reconcile SI notices with TED records.
queries_used: statistika javnega naročanja portal odprti podatki OPSI "javna naročila" evidenčna naročila dataset

candidates.source_name: OPSI dataset – Pregled objavljenih pogodb po oddaji javnega naročila
candidates.why_relevant: Published contracts after award — the deepest available layer of contract-level ground truth (actual scope, duration, price schedules) for state purchases of payment/banking services and IT.
candidates.source_subtype: open data bulk dataset / contract register
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Bulk download; extract contract PDFs where linked and mine for named subcontractors, hardware brands and per-unit pricing.
queries_used: statistika javnega naročanja portal odprti podatki OPSI "javna naročila" evidenčna naročila dataset

candidates.source_name: OPSI dataset – Seznam aktualnih javnih naročil v IS e-JN
candidates.why_relevant: Live pipeline list (authority, subject, deadlines, bid-opening time, status) — early warning on upcoming banking/payments tenders before any award exists.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Daily pull; keyword alerting on payments/banking terms, then follow zadevaId into e-JN.
queries_used: statistika javnega naročanja portal odprti podatki OPSI "javna naročila" evidenčna naročila dataset

candidates.source_name: OPSI dataset – Zbirka letnih statističnih poročil o oddanih javnih naročilih
candidates.why_relevant: Annual government statistical reports on awarded contracts give aggregate market size and category trends, useful for sanity-checking bottom-up vendor totals derived from individual notices.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Annual manual pull of the PDF plus dataset resources; extract category tables.
queries_used: statistika javnega naročanja portal odprti podatki OPSI "javna naročila" evidenčna naročila dataset

candidates.source_name: Direktorat za javno naročanje (MJU) – sistem javnega naročanja / e-JN
candidates.why_relevant: Policy owner of the SI procurement system; publishes guidance, thresholds, statistical reports and the map of which portal carries what. Essential for interpreting notice semantics and procedure types correctly (e.g. 'postopek s pogajanji brez predhodne objave' = single-source award, a strong incumbent signal).
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Occasional manual review; monitor guidance and annual statistical report releases.
queries_used: e-JN portal javno naročilo obvestilo o oddaji naročila plačilne storitve banka

candidates.source_name: Smernice za javno naročanje informacijskih rešitev (MJU/GZS)
candidates.why_relevant: Official guidelines for procuring IT solutions define the standard vocabulary and lot structures Slovenian public buyers use when tendering banking/core-IT systems — a glossary source that improves keyword recall on the notice portals.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: One-off fetch and term extraction into the SI procurement glossary.
queries_used: Banka Slovenije javno naročilo razpis informacijska rešitev objave

candidates.source_name: Banka Slovenije – Katalog informacij javnega značaja
candidates.why_relevant: The central bank's public-information catalogue states that its procurement documentation is published on enarocanje.si and lists its FOI route. It is the authoritative pointer to central-bank purchases of cash-handling, banknote-processing and banking IT — highest-signal buyer in the cell.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monitor page for changes; use as the basis for targeted enarocanje.si queries filtered on naročnik = Banka Slovenije, and as the ZDIJZ request entry point for non-published detail.
queries_used: Banka Slovenije javno naročilo razpis informacijska rešitev objave

candidates.source_name: SID banka – Javna naročila
candidates.why_relevant: State-owned development bank publishing its own procurement calls and conditions. As a bank, its IT, payments and card-services purchases map directly to the vendor landscape this cell tracks.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Periodic page crawl plus cross-check against enarocanje.si notices where naročnik = SID banka.
queries_used: SID banka javna naročila objave razpisi site:sid.si

candidates.source_name: UJP – Uprava RS za javna plačila (jnplacila.si / ujp.gov.si)
candidates.why_relevant: UJP is the state's public-payments authority and an active buyer of payment services: a confirmed award (JNPP 7/2020, ~EUR 49,198.75 incl. VAT) contracted NLB for card/online-banking payment acceptance in the UJP e-Plačila application. Its documentation names accepted schemes and PSP partners (MasterCard, Visa, Maestro, Diners, Activa, VALÚ Moneta, mBills, Abanet, NLB Klik) — a direct partnership map.
candidates.source_subtype: state payments authority / buyer and integration documentation
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl UJP's JN-plačila service and integration docs for supported PSPs/schemes; pair with enarocanje.si notices where naročnik = Ministrstvo za finance / UJP.
candidates.discovered_via_method: snowball from an actual award notice found via seed query
queries_used: Uprava za javna plačila UJP javno naročilo plačilne storitve NLB Klik e-plačila oddaja naročila
local_language_terms_used: postopek s pogajanji brez predhodne objave

candidates.source_name: Državna revizijska komisija (DKOM) – odločitve in iskalnik
candidates.why_relevant: Review decisions on challenged procurements are published in full and routinely quote tender requirements, competitor names, bid prices and technical objections that the sanitised award notice omits. Losing bidders' arguments are one of the few windows into competitive positioning and pricing in SI banking/payments tenders.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Keyword search the decision search engine (bančne storitve, plačilni promet, POS terminali, bankomati, gotovina) and crawl decision detail pages; also monitor 'zadeve v odločanju' for live disputes.
queries_used: Državna revizijska komisija DKOM odločitve javna naročila bančne storitve

candidates.source_name: OpenTender (Government Transparency Institute) – EU/SI procurement
candidates.why_relevant: Third-party normalisation of TED plus national portals across 35 jurisdictions including Slovenia, in OCDS-compatible form. Useful as a cleaned cross-check and for cross-border vendor comparison (does a vendor winning in SI also win in HR/RS/AT?).
candidates.legal_status: third-party republication of open data; check dataset licence
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Bulk OCDS download; treat as secondary — always reconcile vendor names back to enarocanje.si/TED primary notices, since aggregator coverage lags and can drop fields.
queries_used: opentender.eu Slovenia public procurement data OR "TED API" v3 search notices developer

candidates.source_name: Bankart d.o.o. – pridobiteljstvo / processing services
candidates.why_relevant: The shared Slovenian card processor sits behind most acquiring and POS/ATM arrangements that public and state-owned buyers contract for. Its service descriptions let award notices that name only a bank be decoded into the actual technical vendor chain (acquirer -> processor -> terminal supplier).
candidates.source_subtype: vendor/processor site used as decoding key
candidates.legal_status: commercial site; observe terms of use
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Low-frequency crawl of service and partner pages; use for entity resolution, not as an authority on contract values.
queries_used: enarocanje.si obvestilo o oddaji naročila POS terminali bankomati

candidates.source_name: Pošta Slovenije – POS terminali (state-owned buyer/reseller)
candidates.why_relevant: A large state-owned enterprise that both buys and distributes POS acceptance, and is itself a contracting authority under SI procurement rules. Its terminal and payment-partner disclosures identify who supplies the state-owned distribution channel.
candidates.legal_status: commercial site; observe terms of use
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Low-frequency crawl; pair with enarocanje.si searches on naročnik = Pošta Slovenije for the procurement side.
queries_used: enarocanje.si obvestilo o oddaji naročila POS terminali bankomati

candidates.source_name: Lawinsider (SL) – razpisna dokumentacija corpus
candidates.why_relevant: Third-party corpus that has captured Slovenian 'razpisna dokumentacija' (tender documents) which are often removed from the originating portal after the deadline. Useful for retrieving historic tender specifications when the primary source has rotated them out.
candidates.legal_status: third-party republication; licence unclear, treat as read-only reference
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Manual reference lookup only. Do not bulk-scrape; prefer the primary portal or a ZDIJZ request for the same document.
queries_used: Banka Slovenije javno naročilo razpis informacijska rešitev objave
candidates.observed_blocker: Search results surface documents but the site is known to gate full contract text behind registration/subscription; not verified in this pass.

candidates.why_relevant: English mirror of the master register; easier normalisation of entity-type labels and useful for cross-referencing SI entities with EBA/ECB EU-level registers.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Fetch in parallel with the SL page to build a bilingual entity-type mapping table.
candidates.discovered_via_method: English-language search on EEA passporting into Slovenia
queries_used: EBA credit institutions register payment institutions Slovenia passporting list

candidates.source_name: Banka Slovenije - Register placilnih institucij / Register of payment institutions
candidates.why_relevant: Dedicated sub-register of authorised payment institutions (including hybrid PIs), their agents (zastopniki) in SI and host states, and branches. This is the exact list of licensed non-bank payment competitors relevant to a POS/payments vendor.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scheduled fetch of the register page and any attached PDF/XLS list; extract PI name, licence date, services (PSD2 service numbers), agents; diff monthly.
candidates.discovered_via_method: snowballed from the master supervised-entities register and confirmed via EN search
queries_used: EBA credit institutions register payment institutions Slovenia passporting list

candidates.source_name: Banka Slovenije - Placilne storitve in storitve izdajanja elektronskega denarja (licensing gateway)
candidates.why_relevant: Describes licence categories, AISP registration procedure and hybrid-PI conditions - the taxonomy needed to classify actors correctly when building the competitor universe.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: One-off fetch to build the licence-type ontology; re-check after PSD3/PSR transposition.
queries_used: Banka Slovenije register placilnih institucij druzbe za izdajo elektronskega denarja

candidates.source_name: Banka Slovenije - Katalog zbirk podatkov: Seznam notificiranih placilnih institucij (PDF)
candidates.why_relevant: Data-catalogue entry documenting the official dataset 'list of notified payment institutions' - tells you what fields BSI holds and under which legal basis, which is how you request or justify structured extraction.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: One-off download and parse to document dataset schema and update cadence.
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language search surfaced the catalogue PDF directly
queries_used: Banka Slovenije register zastopnikov placilnih institucij hibridne placilne institucije seznam

candidates.source_name: EBA central register of payment and electronic money institutions (PSD2 register)
candidates.why_relevant: EU-wide register mirroring national registers, updated at least daily, with passporting detail per host member state. Filtering to home=SI gives outbound SI firms; filtering host=SI gives every foreign PI/EMI entitled to serve Slovenia - the single most complete inbound-competitor list.
candidates.source_subtype: EU supervisory register with downloadable data
candidates.access_status: public web app; bulk download typically offered as CSV/XLSX; search UI is JS-heavy so plain fetch may return a shell
candidates.legal_status: official EU register, reuse permitted under EBA legal notice with attribution
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Prefer the register's bulk export file (daily/periodic CSV) over scraping the UI; if the UI is required, drive it with a headless browser and filter on country = SI for both home and host.
candidates.discovered_via_method: English search on EU passporting registers, snowballed from EBA registers hub
queries_used: EBA credit institutions register payment institutions Slovenia passporting list
candidates.observed_blocker: Search UI is a JavaScript single-page app; unverified whether a static export URL is directly fetchable.

candidates.source_name: EBA - Registers and other lists of institutions (hub)
candidates.why_relevant: Index of all EBA registers (credit institutions, payment/e-money institutions, crowdfunding, credit servicers). Stable entry point for locating the current data-download URLs, which change between releases.
candidates.legal_status: official EU content, reuse with attribution
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Quarterly crawl to refresh download URLs for each register feed.
queries_used: EBA credit institutions register payment institutions Slovenia passporting list

candidates.source_name: EBA Credit Institutions Register (CRD credit institutions, EEA and non-EEA branches)
candidates.why_relevant: Authoritative list of authorised credit institutions per country including branches passporting into SI. Defines the bank-side actor universe (the buyer set for a POS/banking vendor) with stable identifiers (LEI, authorisation dates).
candidates.source_subtype: EU licence register with periodic data file
candidates.legal_status: official EU register, reuse with attribution
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Download the periodic register file, filter country=SI, join to BSI register and AJPES by name/LEI.
queries_used: EBA credit institutions register payment institutions Slovenia passporting list

candidates.source_name: ECB Banking Supervision - List of supervised entities
candidates.why_relevant: Monthly SSM list distinguishing significant institutions (ECB-supervised) from less significant ones supervised by Banka Slovenije, with group structures. Tells you which SI banks are decided locally versus at group/parent level - directly relevant to who buys and who signs.
candidates.legal_status: official ECB publication, reuse with attribution
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monthly download of the list file; filter country=SI; track SI/LSI status changes and parent-group linkages.
candidates.discovered_via_method: inferred from first principles (SSM must publish the supervised-entity list); URL from prior knowledge, not confirmed in this run's search results
queries_used: EBA credit institutions register payment institutions Slovenia passporting list
candidates.observed_blocker: URL not confirmed by a search result in this run - treat as unverified pending the deterministic liveness pass.

candidates.source_name: OPSI - Poslovni register Slovenije open dataset (AJPES)
candidates.why_relevant: Machine-readable, free-to-reuse extract of the business register published twice a month (CSV/XML): registration number, full name, address, legal form, registering authority. The cleanest legal way to bulk-build the SI actor table and to resolve names appearing in supervisory registers and media.
candidates.legal_status: open data, explicitly published for reuse
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Automated twice-monthly download of the CSV/XML resource; load into the entity master table keyed by maticna stevilka (registration number).
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language search for open-data publication of the business register
queries_used: podatki.gov.si OPSI AJPES poslovni register odprti podatki API SKD 66.190

candidates.source_name: AJPES - Register transakcijskih racunov (RTR) and wsRtrInfoPs web service
candidates.why_relevant: Register of all transaction accounts of business entities held at payment service providers in SI, taken over from Banka Slovenije in 2010. Because every account carries its provider's bank code, aggregate RTR data indirectly reveals which PSPs serve which corporate segments - a rare structural view of banking market share by counterparty, and confirmation of which PSPs actually operate accounts in SI.
candidates.source_subtype: statutory account register + subscription web service
candidates.access_status: public per-entity lookup free; full database via eRTR / wsRtrInfoPs subscription (XML daily changes or monthly snapshot). Natural-person accounts (type A) are NOT public.
candidates.legal_status: statutory register (Akt o vodenju registra transakcijskih racunov); business-entity data reusable under AJPES terms, personal accounts restricted
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Subscribe to the wsRtrInfoPs XML feed / monthly snapshot for business-entity accounts only; aggregate by bank code. Never collect natural-person account data.
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language search on RTR reuse and open data
queries_used: AJPES register transakcijskih racunov RTR ponovna uporaba odprti podatki

candidates.source_name: AJPES - eObjave v postopkih vpisov v poslovni in sodni register
candidates.why_relevant: Official publication stream of registrations and changes (new companies, capital changes, mergers, name/activity changes, liquidations). Acts as an event feed that flags new fintech entrants and restructurings weeks before any press coverage.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Daily/weekly poll of the publication list; filter entries whose SKD activity or company name matches the payments/fintech/IT glossary.
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language search on sodni register / AJPES publications
queries_used: "sodni register" e-sodstvo Slovenija iskanje po subjektih AJPES JOLP letna porocila

candidates.source_name: Sodni register RS (court register public books, sodisce.si / AJPES portal)
candidates.why_relevant: The legally constitutive register for companies (d.o.o., d.d.): founders, shareholders, representatives, supervisory board members, share capital. This is where ownership and control of Slovenian payment/fintech actors and their partners is established, and it supports connected-person snowballing.
candidates.access_status: public; main-book data accessible free via the AJPES web portal after free registration
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Targeted per-entity lookups for the licensed actors identified from BSI/EBA registers; extract ownership and officer graphs rather than bulk scraping.
queries_used: "sodni register" e-sodstvo Slovenija iskanje po subjektih AJPES JOLP letna porocila

candidates.source_name: AJPES JOLP - Javna objava letnih porocil (public annual reports)
candidates.why_relevant: Statutory public filing of annual reports and financial statements for all SI companies. Once the licensed-actor list is built from BSI/EBA, JOLP turns each name into revenue, headcount and ownership trend data - the quantitative backbone for competitor sizing.
candidates.access_status: public search; some aggregated/bulk financial products are paid
candidates.legal_status: statutory publication (ZGD-1); reuse of bulk data under AJPES terms
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Annual per-entity retrieval for the licensed actor list after the filing deadline (spring); parse key financials into the actor table.
candidates.discovered_via_method: inferred from first principles (who must publish accounts) and cross-referenced against AJPES service pages; exact JOLP URL path not confirmed in this run
queries_used: "sodni register" e-sodstvo Slovenija iskanje po subjektih AJPES JOLP letna porocila
candidates.observed_blocker: JOLP path not directly confirmed by a search result in this run; enter via https://www.ajpes.si/ if it does not resolve.

candidates.source_name: ATVP - Registri (Securities Market Agency register index)
candidates.why_relevant: Index of ATVP's statutory registers. ATVP is the second Slovenian supervisor of relevance: it licenses investment firms and, under MiCA, crypto-asset service providers - actors that increasingly overlap with payments.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Quarterly crawl of the index to enumerate live sub-registers, then diff each list.
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language search on ATVP supervised entities
queries_used: ATVP register borznoposredniskih druzb nadzorovani subjekti seznam

candidates.source_name: ATVP - Ponudniki investicijskih storitev (investment service providers: BPD and banks)
candidates.why_relevant: Lists brokerage houses (borznoposredniske druzbe) and banks authorised to provide investment services in SI. Together with the BSI register it completes the licensed-financial-actor picture and identifies institutions that buy trading/payment technology.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Quarterly HTML fetch and diff.
queries_used: ATVP register borznoposredniskih druzb nadzorovani subjekti seznam

candidates.source_name: ATVP - Register odvisnih borznoposredniskih zastopnikov (tied agents register)
candidates.why_relevant: Statutory register (Art. 278 ZTFI-1) of tied agents established in SI and from other EU member states. The agent/intermediary layer is the distribution channel of financial products and mirrors the payment-agent (zastopnik) concept in the BSI register.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Quarterly fetch and diff; map agent-to-principal relationships as a partnership graph.
queries_used: ATVP register borznoposredniskih druzb nadzorovani subjekti seznam

candidates.source_name: ATVP - MiCA / CASP authorisation information and register (crypto-asset service providers in SI)
candidates.why_relevant: ATVP is the SI competent authority authorising CASPs under MiCA. The authorised-CASP list is the newest slice of the payments-adjacent competitor universe (stablecoin/e-money overlap, crypto acquiring). ATVP also publishes warnings about unauthorised firms, itself a discovery signal.
candidates.access_status: public PDF; the live CASP list sits under the ATVP registers/nadzorovani subjekti section
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Locate the live CASP list under a-tvp.si registers; quarterly diff. Cross-check with the ESMA EU-level MiCA register.
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language search on MiCA/CASP registers in SI
queries_used: Banka Slovenije register ponudnikov storitev s kriptosredstvi MiCA CASP seznam
local_language_terms_used: ponudnik storitev v zvezi s kriptosredstvi
candidates.observed_blocker: Exact URL of the live SI CASP list was not surfaced; only the ATVP MiCA leaflet and register index were confirmed.

candidates.source_name: ESMA registers and data (MiCA CASP register, EU level)
candidates.why_relevant: EU-level register where MiCA-authorised CASPs (including SI-authorised firms and those passporting into SI) are consolidated; complements ATVP for the crypto-payments overlap.
candidates.legal_status: official EU register, reuse with attribution
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Use the register's export/CSV where offered; filter home/host country = SI.
candidates.discovered_via_method: inferred from MiCA institutional design; referenced indirectly by SI-language MiCA material, exact URL not confirmed in a search result this run
queries_used: Banka Slovenije register ponudnikov storitev s kriptosredstvi MiCA CASP seznam
candidates.observed_blocker: URL not confirmed in this run's results - unverified.

candidates.why_relevant: Commercial aggregator that tracks MiCA authorisations per country and names SI-authorised CASPs (e.g. ILIRIKA borzno posredniska hisa d.d., INCREMENTUM d.o.o., Orcabay d.o.o.). Useful as a fast cross-check and change alert, but it is a secondary source and must be validated against ATVP/ESMA before use.
candidates.access_status: public web page; commercial site, terms unreviewed
candidates.legal_status: private site - check ToS before automated collection
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Low-frequency manual or light fetch as a tripwire only; never treat as authoritative - confirm every entry against ATVP/ESMA.
candidates.discovered_via_method: surfaced while searching for the official SI CASP register
queries_used: Banka Slovenije register ponudnikov storitev s kriptosredstvi MiCA CASP seznam

candidates.source_name: ZBS – Združenje bank Slovenije (Bank Association of Slovenia) – members page (Članice)
candidates.why_relevant: Authoritative enumeration of the entire Slovenian demand side for banking technology: banks, savings banks (hranilnice) and leasing companies. Logos observed include NLB, Intesa Sanpaolo, OTP, Sparkasse, Addiko, BKS, Gorenjska banka, DBS, Delavska hranilnica, LON, SID, SKB and 10+ leasing firms. candidates.why_relevant: Committee/section structure (e.g. payments, IT/security, cards) names the bank staff and working bodies that vendors sell into and co-present with; committee membership reveals which institutions drive shared-infrastructure decisions (payments, instant payments, anti-fraud).
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Semi-annual fetch; extract committee names + member institutions into actor graph.
candidates.discovered_via_method: snowball from ZBS members page fetch
queries_used: Združenje bank Slovenije člani banke ZBS

candidates.why_relevant: Association news items name supervisory-board members per bank and announce sector-wide projects (payments schemes, digital identity, education centre). Useful for dating leadership change and for spotting collective procurement/infrastructure initiatives that vendors bid into.

queries_used: Združenje bank Slovenije člani banke ZBS

candidates.why_relevant: The single highest-yield artefact for this cell: a maintained, dated (July 2026) roster of Slovenian ICT companies inside the national chamber. queries_used: ZIT Združenje za informatiko in telekomunikacije GZS seznam članov

candidates.why_relevant: ZIT organises vendors into thematic sections and working groups (cybersecurity, digital skills, e-business). Section leadership is drawn from vendor management, so these pages map which firms claim authority in which technology area — a cheap proxy for competitor positioning.

queries_used: ZIT Združenje za informatiko in telekomunikacije GZS seznam članov

candidates.source_name: GZS ZIT – Upravni odbor (management board)
candidates.why_relevant: Board seats are held by executives of the leading Slovenian ICT vendors; the roster is a ranked-by-influence shortlist of the firms that shape ICT policy and are best placed to win bank contracts.

queries_used: ZIT Združenje za informatiko in telekomunikacije GZS seznam članov

candidates.source_name: GZS ZIT – news feed (member position papers, consultations)
candidates.why_relevant: ZIT publishes member responses to national digital strategy consultations; these documents name contributing companies and reveal their stated capability areas and commercial interests (e.g. digital identity, cloud, AI) relevant to bank tenders.

negative_findings.description: Global core-banking vendors publish essentially nothing in Slovene; local-language queries surfaced local vendors (HRC, SETCCE, Halcom) and press, but no sl-language page on temenos.com, backbase.com, mambu.com or finacle.com.

negative_findings.why_it_matters: For this cell the local-language channel is productive for the LOCAL vendor tier and for incident-driven disclosure, while the global-vendor tier must be tracked in English. Collection design should split accordingly.

negative_findings.description: The Mambu customer-story index URL was inferred from standard vendor site structure and was not confirmed by a fetch in this pass.

negative_findings.description: No public tender or contract-award document for any Slovenian bank's ATM fleet purchase, renewal or maintenance was found on the public procurement portal or elsewhere.
negative_findings.result_summary: Procurement searches returned only the ZJN-3 legal framework and unrelated contracting authorities. No bank ATM notices surfaced.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: This is structural, not a search failure: Slovenian commercial banks are private entities and not contracting authorities under ZJN-3, so their ATM and self-service purchases are never published. Competitive intelligence in this cell therefore cannot rely on procurement records for the bank channel and must be reconstructed from installed-base observation (ATMinfo/locator diffs), service-partner disclosure and vendor press. The exception worth monitoring is Posta Slovenije and other state-linked buyers, which the draft cash-access law would draw into the cash-point obligation.

negative_findings.description: No Slovenian bank was found publishing the identity of its ATM hardware or service supplier in any press release, annual report page or news article located in this pass, including for NLB, the largest fleet owner.
negative_findings.result_summary: Targeted Slovenian searches on NLB ATM procurement returned only locator pages, general terms and mobile-branch marketing - no supplier, contract or vendor name.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Supplier attribution in this market must be inferred from second-order evidence: local service-partner customer logo walls (Demi Trade names NLB, NKBM, SKB and UniCredit), OEM press releases, and physical/photographic identification of machine models. Any vendor-share estimate built for Slovenia should be labelled as inferred, with its evidence chain recorded.

negative_findings.description: The Slovenian term 'bankomat' is heavily overloaded in consumer contexts and dominates search results with fee, locator and consumer-advice content, while the technically precise industry terms are far rarer.
negative_findings.result_summary: Consumer-facing pages crowded out supply-side results in nearly every 'bankomat' query. 'Recikliranje gotovine' as a Slovenian rendering of cash recycling returned essentially nothing supply-side; the market instead speaks of 'polog gotovine' and 'avtomatski polog'.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Future collection should prefer the lower-noise supply-side vocabulary - 'bancni avtomat', 'upravljanje mreze bancnih avtomatov', 'samopostrezni terminal', 'bancna oprema', 'avtomatski polog gotovine', 'blagajniski sef', 'menjalni avtomat' - and should not expect a Slovenian-language equivalent of 'cash recycler' to exist as a marketing term.

negative_findings.description: Slovenian business press with the most likely supply-side reporting (Finance.si in particular) did not surface usable articles for this cell and is substantially subscription-gated.
negative_findings.result_summary: A targeted Finance.si-oriented query returned Delo, Monitor and Microsoft marketing pages instead of Finance.si articles, indicating either weak indexing or paywall exclusion.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Finance.si and similar B2B outlets are the most likely place a Slovenian bank's technology investment or supplier switch would be reported. A subscription and manual archive search should be treated as a required capability for this cell rather than assuming open-web coverage is sufficient.

negative_findings.description: No Slovenian banking references found for Marand d.o.o. Two searches (sl: 'Marand banka rešitve reference slovenska banka projekt'; sl/en: 'Marand d.o.o. reference finance bančništvo Nova KBM OR NLB rešitev') returned only generic bank pages and one marketing-agency client list mentioning Marand Inženiring.
negative_findings.result_summary: Marand's public footprint in search does not include a banking vertical; its visible positioning is engineering and health informatics.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The cell brief lists Marand as a bank-serving IT house. If that is wrong, tracking effort should be reallocated to Hrc, Halcom, SRC and Bankart, which do have evidenced bank relationships.

negative_findings.description: No company named 'Result d.o.o.' with a Slovenian banking practice could be located. The sl query 'Result d.o.o. banka rešitve reference Slovenija bančništvo' returned only bank websites, a Wikipedia bank list and — usefully — Hrc/Hibis. The name is also a highly noisy search term in Slovenian ('result' appears in unrelated contexts).
negative_findings.result_summary: Actor unconfirmed; possibly a mis-transcribed or renamed entity.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Prevents an invented source entry, and flags that the actor list in the cell brief needs verification against AJPES/bizi before further searching.

negative_findings.description: Endava's Slovenian unit (Endava digitalne rešitve d.o.o., Ljubljana) publishes no client list or Slovenia-specific banking case studies discoverable via search; only entity data (address, ~231 staff, ~USD 36m sales) and a Facebook office post surfaced.
negative_findings.result_summary: Foreign-owned delivery centres in SI are opaque about which bank clients their local staff serve.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Nearshore delivery centres are a real channel for foreign payments platforms into the region, but their SI footprint must be inferred from job ads and global case studies rather than a local reference page.

negative_findings.description: No Slovenian-language Comtrade site with a banking reference/customer page surfaced. Queries returned only registry aggregators (bizi.si, companywall.si) and a procurement supplier page. The group's regional banking material appears to live on non-SI Comtrade domains not reached in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Comtrade's SI banking references are not directly discoverable from SI-scoped search; procurement records are the workable substitute.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Comtrade is a large regional integrator; missing its reference page leaves a gap in the vendor-to-bank relationship map that must be closed via procurement and job-ad evidence.

negative_findings.description: Slovenian searches for Halcom project-level news ('Halcom novice reference banka implementacija ... digitalno bančništvo projekt') returned only product and about pages, not a datable newsroom index. A Halcom newsroom/press URL was therefore NOT recorded, to avoid inventing one.
negative_findings.result_summary: Halcom product and support pages are well indexed; its news/press stream is not, from search alone.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Halcom is the highest-profile SI banking-software exporter; without a newsroom feed, deal announcements will be missed. A manual site-navigation pass is needed to locate the real press URL.

negative_findings.description: Several cell terms are noisy in Slovenian search: 'reference' also means bank account references and job references; 'banka' matches the bank's own marketing pages far more strongly than supplier pages; 'Result' and 'Špica' ('špica' = peak/rush hour) are common words. Company-name queries reliably return registry aggregators rather than the vendor's own site.
negative_findings.result_summary: Brand+topic queries in sl are dominated by bank sites and registry aggregators.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Future collection should query with vendor-specific product names (Hibis, Hal E-Bank, bizBox, e-GenDoc, mIA, Kadris) rather than generic 'banka rešitve reference', which materially improves precision.

negative_findings.description: Bankart publishes no 'Partnerji' / 'Partners' or 'Reference' page, and no client-bank list. Repeated SL and EN queries for Bankart partner/technology pages returned only service, careers and news pages.
negative_findings.result_summary: The cell's expected 'partner/technology page' artefact does not exist for the single most important actor; partner identity must be reconstructed from news items, supplier case studies and owner-bank disclosures.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Any collection design that assumes a scrapeable Bankart partner directory will silently return nothing; budget must move to supplier-side and press-release harvesting instead.

negative_findings.description: Searches for Bankart tenders/RFPs ('javno narocilo', 'razpis', 'dobavitelj') found no procurement notices. Bankart is a bank-owned private company and is not visible as a contracting authority on enarocanje.si in these results.
negative_findings.result_summary: No public tender trail for the country's main processor; its vendor purchases are commercially confidential.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Bankart's supplier set can only be inferred indirectly (vendor case studies, trade press, job ads), so confidence on stack claims will stay medium at best.

negative_findings.description: The Flik participant-bank list is consistently referenced ('seznam bank najdete na www.flik.si') by Bankart and by member banks, but the exact URL of that list page was not isolated in this pass — only flik.si root and /pravne-osebe surfaced.
negative_findings.result_summary: Pointer confirmed to exist; its precise address unconfirmed.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: This list is the highest-value single artefact in the cell (full instant-payments participant graph); the next pass should crawl flik.si directly rather than rely on search.

negative_findings.description: Several Banka Slovenije payment-system pages surfaced on a staging-style host (bsi.azurewebsites.net) rather than www.bsi.si, and bsi.si URL paths appear in two forms (with and without an /sl/ segment).
negative_findings.result_summary: Canonical URLs for BSI payment-system pages are uncertain; some recorded URLs may redirect.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Liveness verification may report false 404s for BSI paths; the verifier should follow redirects and treat the azurewebsites host as non-canonical.

negative_findings.description: No Slovenian-language term was found for a 'scheme technology partner programme' equivalent (e.g. certified-vendor / partner-programme listings) for Flik or the national rails; searches in SL returned only consumer and bank-facing content.
negative_findings.result_summary: The SI schemes appear not to run public certified-vendor programmes, unlike card schemes internationally.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Vendor certification lists — a standard high-yield source type elsewhere — are likely absent for SI national schemes, and effort should not be spent hunting them.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated Slovenian fintech/payments industry association or member directory was located; searches for a 'Fintech Slovenija' association returned terminology pages and unrelated foreign fintech entries.
negative_findings.result_summary: Best available substitutes are the BSI registers plus the Startup.si ecosystem portal; no membership body page confirmed.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Removes a normally high-yield pointer source (member lists, position papers, event agendas) for enumerating non-bank payment actors.

negative_findings.description: No Slovenian-language Nexi country site or local newsroom (e.g. a nexi.si equivalent to nexi.hr) was found in this pass; local presence surfaced only through company registries and the group site.
negative_findings.result_summary: Nexi Slovenija d.o.o. confirmed as a registered entity (Letališka cesta 29A, Ljubljana; formerly Intesa Sanpaolo Card) but no local press room identified.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Slovenian merchant announcements from the largest regional acquirer may only exist via partner banks' communications, requiring indirect monitoring.

negative_findings.description: No evidence found of Viva.com activity aimed at the Slovenian merchant market despite an explicit local-language query.
negative_findings.result_summary: Query returned SumUp and Revolut material only; Viva.com absent from results.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Either a genuine coverage gap in this market or a search-recall failure; should not be read as absence of the player.

negative_findings.description: The Slovenian register of virtual-currency service providers (ponudniki storitev virtualnih valut) was referenced by a search result title but resolved only to the gov.si homepage.
negative_findings.result_summary: Register exists per result title; deep URL not obtained and not fabricated here.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Needed to enumerate licensed crypto payment actors under the do_not_narrow instruction.

negative_findings.description: Signals conflict on mBills' operational status: the merchant-facing site is live while a FURS notice titled 'Prenehanje delovanja mBills' indicates removal as an eDavki payment option as of mid-2026.
negative_findings.result_summary: Recorded as an open question rather than a verdict; no source was fetched to confirm full wind-down.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Whether the leading independent Slovenian wallet is exiting materially changes the competitive picture for bank wallets and Flik.

negative_findings.description: Across NLB, OTP banka, Gorenjska banka and Delavska hranilnica announcements surfaced in this run, the technology partner is usually NOT named. Banks describe the customer benefit ('prenovljena mobilna banka', 'nova izkušnja digitalnega bančništva') and omit the supplier.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches combining bank names with 'v sodelovanju z' / 'in partnership with' returned launch stories but almost no explicit vendor attribution; the clearest exception was Addiko naming the state SI-PASS eID service.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The buyer-side cell cannot be relied on alone for vendor attribution. It must be joined to vendor case studies (A6 vendor cell) and to procurement records, with the bank release supplying date and scope rather than the partner name.

negative_findings.description: Several smaller institutions (Primorska hranilnica Vipava, Deželna banka Slovenije, BKS Bank Slovenia branch, Hranilnica LON) surfaced with product and location pages but no discoverable press-release section in these searches.
negative_findings.result_summary: sl-language queries returned homepages, product pages and third-party aggregator profiles rather than any 'sporočila za javnost' or 'novice' index for these institutions.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: For the tail of the market, technology change must be inferred from product-page and T&C diffs rather than announcements — a different, slower collection method that must be planned for explicitly.

negative_findings.description: Nova KBM and SKB banka ceased to exist as brands and merged into OTP banka; Abanka, Sberbank/N Banka and Summit Leasing have likewise been absorbed. Their historical newsrooms are at risk of disappearing.
negative_findings.result_summary: Search results confirm the NKBM+SKB to OTP merger completion and the migration of customers to unified digital channels; legacy domains were not confirmed live in this run.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Pre-merger go-live announcements are the record of which vendors those banks bought. If nkbm.si and skb.si are retired without archival, that history is lost — archive.org captures should be secured now.

negative_findings.description: Newsroom URLs for Banka Sparkasse (sparkasse.si), Hranilnica LON (lon.si), UniCredit Banka Slovenija and BKS Bank Slovenia were inferred from brand names and regulator register entries, not observed in search results.
negative_findings.result_summary: The Banka Slovenije supervised-entity register confirmed the legal entities exist; the corporate domains and their news paths were not directly observed.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: These must be resolved by the deterministic liveness pass before being treated as sources; recording them as confirmed would violate the no-fabrication rule.

negative_findings.description: No Slovenian bank technology/engineering blog (the kind that describes architecture and named platforms) was found in this run — neither in Slovenian nor English.
negative_findings.result_summary: Queries for bank digital-transformation pages returned marketing and strategy pages only; the nearest equivalent is the ZBS 'posvet informatikov' conference release and the SRC integrator magazine.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Removes the richest potential buyer-side technical source category for this market. Conference proceedings and integrator publications must substitute.

negative_findings.description: Searches in Slovenian for municipal/state tenders using 'gotovinsko poslovanje', 'prevzem gotovine' and 'bančne storitve' returned consumer-banking and accounting content, not procurement notices.
negative_findings.result_summary: General web search does not index enarocanje.si notice bodies well; no cash-handling award notices were surfaced this way despite correct local-language terms.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms that keyword discovery must be run inside the portal / bulk datasets rather than via general web search; a general-search-only collector would systematically miss cash-handling and CIT contracts.

negative_findings.description: Fetch of the enarocanje.si homepage returned only the portal title; no search URL pattern, RSS feed, or export/API endpoint could be read from the landing page.
negative_findings.result_summary: Notice URL pattern (/Obrazci/?id_obrazec=NNNNNN) is known only from individual notices found via search engines. This is an unverified hypothesis about the site, not a verdict that no search exists.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The collection design for the single most important source in this cell should not depend on scraping an undocumented UI; the OPSI bulk datasets are the safer enumeration route.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated Banka Slovenije procurement listing page was found; its FOI catalogue instead points to enarocanje.si as the publication venue.
negative_findings.result_summary: Central-bank procurements must be reached by filtering the national portal on naročnik, not by a bsi.si tender page.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Avoids a wasted collector against a page that does not exist and pins the correct access route for the highest-value buyer in this cell.

negative_findings.description: English-language search for TED contract award notices covering Slovenian payment terminals / banking services returned platform documentation and unrelated notices, not SI-specific awards.
negative_findings.result_summary: TED content is not reliably discoverable through general web search; the Search API or on-site expert query is required.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Sets the expectation that TED must be collected programmatically with country and CPV filters, not by keyword browsing.

negative_findings.description: No standalone, separately published Banka Slovenije register of payment-institution AGENTS (zastopniki) and hybrid payment institutions was located as its own URL. Local-language searching indicates agents are recorded as fields inside the payment-institution and e-money-institution registers rather than as a distinct public list.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searched 'register zastopnikov placilnih institucij' and 'hibridne placilne institucije seznam'; results returned only the master supervised-entities register, the non-bank PSP supervision hub and the ZPlaSS/ZPlaSSIED legal texts.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The agent layer is where distribution partnerships live. If agent data is only embedded per-institution, collection must parse entity detail pages rather than a single list, which changes the extraction design.

negative_findings.description: The EBA central PSD2 register search application, the ECB SSM supervised-entities list, the ESMA MiCA register and the AJPES JOLP path were not directly confirmed by a fetched page in this run.
negative_findings.result_summary: These URLs are recorded from institutional design and prior knowledge rather than a confirmed search hit or fetch; the EBA search UI in particular is a JavaScript app that plain fetching may not render.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The deterministic liveness pass must resolve these before they are treated as collectable. A failed fetch on them should be read as bot-defence/JS-rendering, not as a dead source.

negative_findings.description: Full bulk access to AJPES RTR and to aggregated financial data is not open data - it requires eRTR registration or a paid subscription under the AJPES price list, and natural-person accounts (type A) are legally excluded from publication.
negative_findings.result_summary: AJPES pages describe wsRtrInfoPs and bulk file subscription as reuse services with a cenik; only business-entity account data is public.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Budget and a data-reuse agreement may be needed; personal-account data must never be collected, which constrains any account-level analysis to legal entities.

negative_findings.description: No Slovenian public register was found that enumerates POS/payment-terminal vendors, acquirers' technology suppliers or payment-software integrators as such - i.e. there is no licence list for the vendor side of the market.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches for activity-based enumeration only lead back to AJPES SKD codes, which are a proxy, not a vendor register.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The vendor universe cannot be built from a statutory list; it must be assembled from AJPES SKD filtering plus public procurement, bank tender awards and partner pages handled by other cells.

negative_findings.description: Statutory registers contain no case-study or partnership-narrative content whatsoever.
negative_findings.result_summary: All sources in this cell yield entity identity, licence scope and status only.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The 'case studies' topic of this run cannot be served from cell 9; it must come from vendor/bank publication cells. Cell 9's contribution is the actor list those cells sample from.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated Slovenian FINTECH industry association with a public member directory was found. Searches in Slovenian for 'fintech združenje Slovenija' returned only blockchain/crypto bodies (Blockchain Alliance Europe, SBCA, Bitcoin društvo Slovenije), not a payments/fintech trade association comparable to e.g. Fintech Austria.
negative_findings.result_summary: Slovenian fintech interests appear to be represented indirectly, via ZBS (bank side), ZIT/GZS (ICT side) and blockchain alliances, rather than by a standalone fintech association.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: There is no single membership list that enumerates Slovenian fintech vendors; A6 vendor discovery must therefore triangulate ZIT + AmCham + DSI sponsors + blockchain alliances instead of relying on one roster.

negative_findings.description: ZBS publishes member logos but no public list of associate/affiliate or supplier members, and no public register of vendors participating in its committees or its education centre (Izobraževalni center) programmes was located in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: ZBS members page enumerates banks, savings banks and leasing companies only; the vendor-facing side of ZBS activity is not published as a directory.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Bank–vendor working relationships visible through association committees must be recovered from event programmes and news items rather than a roster, raising collection cost.

negative_findings.description: GZS's company-data service indicates that basic company contact information is available only to GZS members; the AHK Slovenija online member directory may likewise be partly gated (not confirmed in this pass).
negative_findings.result_summary: Two of the largest chamber directories in scope may be membership-gated rather than openly crawlable.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Budget or partnership decisions may be needed to obtain full chamber rosters; otherwise coverage skews toward associations with open directories (AmCham, BSCC, ZIT PDF).

negative_findings.description: The ZIT member-list PDF URL (04_Seznam članov_JULIJ 2026.pdf) was reported by a fetch of the ZIT Članstvo page but was not itself opened; its filename is date-stamped and will change when the roster is refreshed.
negative_findings.result_summary: URL recorded as a candidate with a note that the dated filename must be re-resolved from the parent page on each run.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Hard-coding the dated PDF URL into a collector will silently break; the collector must resolve the link from the Članstvo page each time.

negative_findings.description: Foreign bilateral chambers beyond AmCham, AHK and BSCC (e.g. French, Italian, Nordic, Dutch chambers in Slovenia) were not searched in this pass due to cell time budget.
negative_findings.result_summary: Coverage of bilateral chambers is partial.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Italian- and Austrian-origin vendors are commercially relevant to Slovenian banking given ownership structures (Intesa Sanpaolo, Sparkasse, BKS, Addiko); their chambers may hold directories not covered here.

coverage_gaps.description: Lending-specific and collections/risk platform vendors (e.g. nCino, Provenir, CRIF, Experian, FIS, SBS/Sopra) were not systematically searched against Slovenian institutions in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a dedicated sweep of lending/decisioning vendor customer pages with the SI institution keyword list, in English, plus Slovene terms 'kreditni proces', 'odobritev kredita', 'bonitetna ocena'.

coverage_gaps.description: The SI institution keyword list used here covered NLB, OTP banka (ex Nova KBM/SKB), Gorenjska banka, Addiko, Delavska hranilnica, Sparkasse, BKS, UniCredit and Intesa Sanpaolo Bank, but not the full set of savings banks, the leasing arms, or the Slovene subsidiaries' group-level IT decisions taken in Vienna/Budapest/Milan.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build a complete SI credit-institution register from Banka Slovenije's supervised-entity list, then re-run vendor-page matching including parent-group naming variants (e.g. OTP Group, Steiermärkische Sparkasse, Sberbank Europe legacy).

coverage_gaps.description: Global vendors' regional implementation-partner networks (the unnamed 'local vendor' credited in the NLB/Temenos R17 upgrade) were not identified.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Crawl vendor partner directories (Temenos partner ecosystem, Backbase partners, Microsoft/Oracle partner finders) filtered to Slovenia/Adriatic, and match partner-site case studies against SI banks.

coverage_gaps.description: All candidates in this slice were discovered via search-result metadata; no page was fetched and confirmed in-session, so page-level content claims rest on search summaries.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run the deterministic liveness + content pass over every URL; treat 403/timeout as bot-defence rather than death, and re-resolve 404s via site search.

coverage_gaps.description: The card management / issuing platform layer under Bankart and under SI banks is unmapped — no named CMS, switch, HSM or tokenisation supplier identified.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Target Bankart annual reports via AJPES, Bankart job postings (technology stack signals), procurement notices, and vendor-side reference pages (OpenWay, Tietoevry, Nexi/SIA, Euronet, BPC, Compass Plus) filtered on Slovenia.

coverage_gaps.description: No recruitment/job-posting sources were collected, though these are among the most reliable public indicators of which payment platforms an organisation actually operates.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add SI job boards (mojedelo.com, zaposlitev.net, LinkedIn Jobs SI) with queries on platform names and roles (kartično poslovanje, plačilni sistemi, ISO 20022, Way4, Base24).

coverage_gaps.description: Conference and industry-association sources for SI payments (Bančni vestnik, Združenje bank Slovenije, ICT/payments conferences) were not covered; these carry vendor presentations naming implementations.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Scout Združenje bank Slovenije (zbs-giz.si), Bančni vestnik archives, and SI/regional payments conference agendas for vendor speaker slots.

coverage_gaps.description: Cross-border consolidation (Nexi Croatia owning Nexi Slovenija; NLB's regional footprint) means SI vendor facts often appear only in HR/RS/BA sources.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Extend queries into hr/sr language sources for the same processing entities and treat regional processor announcements as SI-relevant.

coverage_gaps.description: No candidate URL in this slice was fetched and confirmed; all liveness assessments are search-result-derived only.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run the deterministic verification pass over every URL; re-check Visa/Mastercard directory URLs specifically, as they are JS-driven and may need a headless browser.

coverage_gaps.description: EU-level tender data (TED) and ECB/ESCB oversight publications on SI payment infrastructures were not directly scouted.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add TED (ted.europa.eu) with CPV codes for payment/banking IT services filtered to SI, plus ECB oversight and SEPA migration reports.

coverage_gaps.description: Sponsor and exhibitor rosters are typically deleted or replaced when a conference site rolls to the next edition. DSI is the exception (per-year subdomains 2021-2026); Money Motion partly (year subdomains); most others keep only the current edition.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Backfill via Wayback Machine snapshots of sponsor/exhibitor pages for INFOSEK, NT konferenca, CIO Summit, Money Motion and the Finance conference portfolio before running forward collection.

coverage_gaps.description: Sponsor tiers on Money Motion, INFOSEK and DSI are rendered as logo images, sometimes without informative alt text, so plain HTML scraping will under-recover vendor names.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build an image/OCR + logo-matching step into the collection method for sponsor pages, and cross-validate against post-event press coverage naming sponsors in text.

coverage_gaps.description: NT konferenca, CIO Summit and WEBSI were reached only via a media calendar or press coverage; their canonical organiser domains were not confirmed in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Resolve official domains for NT konferenca (organiser believed to be Kompas Xnet), CIO Summit Slovenia, and WEBSI, then re-scope those candidates to their primary sites.

coverage_gaps.description: The highest-signal Slovenian payments gathering (ZBS posvetovanje o kartičnem poslovanju) is a member consultation whose detailed agenda may not be published openly; only a descriptive blurb was found.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Attempt to retrieve annual agenda PDFs from the ZBS terminski plan and vsa-izobrazevanja pages; if gated, fall back to the ZBS letno poročilo which records events retrospectively, and to attendee LinkedIn posts.

coverage_gaps.description: Only Money Motion was covered on the regional axis. Other Adriatic/CEE payments and banking events that Slovenian banks attend (e.g. Croatian, Serbian and Austrian banking/cards conferences) were not enumerated.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a follow-up sweep using paytech.events, europeandigitalfinance.eu and 10times filtered to HR/RS/AT/HU, then check which Slovenian institutions appear on their speaker lists.

coverage_gaps.description: No social-listening source was recorded for conference attendance, which in practice is where Slovenian vendor and bank staff self-declare presence at events (booth photos, 'we are at X' posts).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a LinkedIn/company-newsroom monitoring rule keyed to event hashtags and Slovenian vendor pages, as a complement to official sponsor pages.

coverage_gaps.description: Only DIGGIT was confirmed to have an explicit financial-services/insurance/banking award category. Whether WEBSI, Netko and GZS innovation awards carry a finance-specific category was not established.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Fetch the rules/category pages for WEBSI, Netko and GZS priznanja to determine whether finance-specific filtering is possible, or whether full winner lists must be classified post hoc.

coverage_gaps.description: No licensed access path established to the two paywalled cornerstones of this cell: Casnik Finance (finance.si, Moje finance, Manager) and the STA wire.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Procure a Finance.si subscription and evaluate an STA wire or media-monitoring contract (e.g. a Slovenian clipping service); until then, rely on downstream free reprints and label the resulting coverage as partial.

coverage_gaps.description: Only current-web coverage was reached; no Slovenian newspaper archive (Delo/Dnevnik/Vecer digital archives, Digitalna knjiznica Slovenije dLib) was explored for historical bank-IT supplier reporting.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a dedicated pass over dLib.si and the paid Delo/Dnevnik archives for pre-2015 tenders and incumbent history, which anchors current displacement analysis.

coverage_gaps.description: Non-Ljubljana outlets (Vecer in Maribor, regional business weeklies) and RTVSLO's business desk were not covered in this pass; regional banks and savings banks (hranilnice) are typically covered there rather than nationally.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Extend the cell with vecer.com, rtvslo.si/gospodarstvo and hranilnica-focused coverage; add Slovene terms 'hranilnica', 'Delavska hranilnica', 'Primorska hranilnica'.

coverage_gaps.description: Slovene procurement/technology vocabulary for this domain was only partially exercised - terms not yet searched include 'javno narocilo', 'razpis', 'izvajalec', 'sistemski integrator', 'procesni center', 'karticno poslovanje', 'POS terminali', 'jedrni bancni sistem', 'zaledni sistem'.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a second local-language sweep with the full glossary across najdi.si Novice, Monitor and Racunalniske novice site search before declaring the cell complete.

coverage_gaps.description: Much of the freely accessible Slovenian IT trade content (Racunalniske novice, SRC InfoSRC) is vendor-supplied advertorial, but no method is yet defined for separating editorial from paid placement.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Define a provenance flag at collection time (byline present, 'promocijsko sporocilo' / 'oglasno sporocilo' marker, vendor-hosted) and downweight credibility accordingly.

coverage_gaps.description: General newswires that carry vendor press releases verbatim (Business Wire, PR Newswire, GlobeNewswire, EIN Presswire) were not searched in this run, yet they are the origination point for many vendor announcements later picked up by Finextra/FinTech Futures.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a dedicated pass on the major PR wires filtered for Slovenia/Slovenian bank names and for vendor names (Oracle, Temenos, Finastra, Nexi/Nets, Diebold, NCR/NCR Atleos, Backbase, Halcom).

coverage_gaps.description: Slovenian-language querying in this cell produced no vendor-selection news; the sl anchors used may be wrong rather than the content absent.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Retry sl queries with procurement and project vocabulary: 'prenova jedrnega bančnega sistema', 'javno naročilo bančna informacijska rešitev', 'implementacija plačilne platforme', 'strateško partnerstvo banka ponudnik', plus hr/sr equivalents for Adriatic spillover.

coverage_gaps.description: Actor map for this cell is anchored on NLB, Bankart, SID Banka and SKB/OTP only; other Slovenian banks (NKBM/OTP, Addiko, Delavska hranilnica, Gorenjska banka, Sparkasse, Intesa Sanpaolo Bank, N Banka) and vendors (Halcom, Actual I.T., Comtrade, Iskratel/S&T-Kontron) were not systematically searched against the trade press.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Iterate one search per bank and per vendor name against Finextra, FinTech Futures and The Paypers site-search to build a complete vendor-win ledger.

coverage_gaps.description: The two highest-value systematic sources (SeeNews full wire, IBSi Sales League Table) are subscription products; free-tier monitoring will only yield headlines.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Scope and price subscriptions before relying on this cell for completeness; in the interim record headline-level entities only and flag confidence accordingly.

coverage_gaps.description: Analyst/consultancy channels that publish vendor-win data (Retail Banker International / GlobalData, The Banker's technology awards and rankings, Celent/Forrester vendor reports) were not covered.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a follow-up cell or pass covering paid analyst coverage and awards write-ups, which often name the Slovenian client explicitly in case studies.

coverage_gaps.description: PSD2/developer portals not yet pinned for several SI ASPSPs: Nova KBM/SKB legacy entities post-OTP merger, LON (Hranilnica LON), Primorska hranilnica Vipava, N26/Revolut-style non-bank PSPs operating in SI, and BKS Bank SI.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Enumerate the full ASPSP list from Banka Slovenije's register and from the Bankart hub tenant paths, then locate each entity's PSD2 page.

coverage_gaps.description: No technical fingerprinting layer defined yet (TLS certificate SANs, HTTP response headers, JS bundle vendor strings, mobile app binary/SDK inspection) — the highest-yield way to read a vendor off a portal that names no vendor.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a passive fingerprinting routine over the confirmed portal hostnames plus APK/IPA metadata for the SI banking app roster; certificate-transparency logs can also reveal new sandbox/API hostnames before launch.

coverage_gaps.description: Job ads and app release notes are ephemeral; nothing in the current source set guarantees historical retention.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Pair every job-board and app-store source with archival (own snapshot store plus Wayback save-page-now) so the dated-evidence property of the cell survives.

coverage_gaps.description: Local-language searching was performed throughout, but no glossary yet exists for the SI-specific terms for card/ATM processing roles and core-banking modules, which limits recall on job boards.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build a sl glossary: jedrni bančni sistem, kartično poslovanje, procesiranje kartic, plačilni promet, takojšnja plačila, odprto bančništvo, peskovnik, razvijalski portal, ponudnik plačilnih storitev, hranilnica; flag noisy terms ('banka' matches Banka Slovenije, 'razvoj' matches business development).

coverage_gaps.description: LinkedIn — probably the richest weak-signal source for this cell — is login-walled and ToS-restricted, so systematic collection is not permissible by scraping.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Decide between licensed access (Sales Navigator / Talent Insights) or a documented manual-analyst review cadence; record the choice so downstream collection stays compliant and GDPR-safe.

coverage_gaps.description: No dedicated source identified for ownership changes at small SI payments/fintech vendors (ISV, POS, core-banking integrators) that fall below merger-notification and takeover thresholds.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build an AJPES-based watchlist of ~30 SI vendor entities and diff ownership/statusne spremembe periodically.

coverage_gaps.description: No structured historical archive of AVK decisions older than the current web listing was located (archive depth unverified).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Test AVK listing pagination and web.archive.org snapshots to establish how far back the record goes.

coverage_gaps.description: Group-level acquirer/processor deals (Nexi, Worldline, Nets, Erste, Intesa, UniCredit) affecting Slovenia are only partly covered by the parent-newsroom sources listed.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a per-group IR/newsroom watchlist for the top 8 foreign parents active in SI and cross-check against EC merger cases.

coverage_gaps.description: Several URLs (AVK news index, ATVP permit lists, MGTŠ FDI pages, NLB IR) were inferred or taken from search results rather than fetched in this run.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Route all candidate URLs through the deterministic liveness pass and correct any moved paths.

coverage_gaps.description: The Bankart open-banking endpoint (openbanking.bankart.si) is only known second-hand, from ATMinfo.si's footer attribution. Its actual structure, access requirements and field set were not established in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Fetch the portal root directly, look for a developer/API documentation section and any ATM-locator endpoint, and determine whether registration is needed. If it exposes structured per-ATM records including deposit capability, it should become the primary installed-base feed for this cell and demote HTML scraping to a fallback.

coverage_gaps.description: Glory Global Solutions - a major cash-recycling and teller-cash-automation competitor named in the cell brief - produced no Slovenian evidence at all, neither a country presence nor a local distributor.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run dedicated Glory-specific searches in Slovenian and Croatian, check Glory's own partner/distributor locator, and search AJPES for any Glory-related entity. Also check whether Glory reaches Slovenia via its Austrian or Italian organisation. Record the outcome explicitly either way so absence becomes an evidenced finding.

coverage_gaps.description: Cash-in-transit and cash-management companies (e.g. Varnost, Sintal, G4S-successor operations in Slovenia) were not investigated, yet they are the operational counterparties for ATM cash replenishment, smart safes and recycling economics, and frequently co-bid or co-deliver with hardware vendors.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Map Slovenian CIT/cash-management providers and their bank contracts; their service pages and references often disclose which ATM and smart-safe equipment they support, providing an independent read on the installed base.

coverage_gaps.description: Posta Slovenije was identified as a named cash-point obligor in the draft cash-access law but was not researched as a buyer of self-service and cash equipment. Unlike commercial banks, it is a state-owned entity and therefore likely a contracting authority publishing tenders.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Investigate Posta Slovenije's procurement pages and its notices on enarocanje.si for self-service kiosk, cash-handling and ATM-related tenders. This is potentially the only channel in this cell where full tender specifications and named contract winners are publicly obtainable.

coverage_gaps.description: No visual/physical identification source was established for determining which ATM makes and models are actually deployed at Slovenian sites - the most reliable way to attribute installed base when neither banks nor vendors disclose it.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Assess whether street-level imagery, bank branch photography, ATMinfo location data joined with photographs, or community photo sources can support model-level identification, and define an ethical, ToS-compliant method before relying on it. Also check ATMIA or ECB-adjacent statistics for any make-level breakdown.

coverage_gaps.description: The Bankart annual report located is the 2019 edition; more recent annual reports and their ATM-count and partner disclosures were not retrieved.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Enumerate the current Bankart annual report archive and pull the most recent three editions to build a current ATM-count and partner time series, rather than relying on the 2019 figure of ~2,007 ATMs across six markets.

coverage_gaps.description: This pass covered Hrc, Halcom, ZZI, SRC, Bankart, Comtrade SI, Špica, Genis, Mikrografija, Agitavit, IN516HT, Comland and Endava SI, but the domestic supplier population is larger. Not yet checked: Kontron/S&T Slovenija, Unistar LC, NIL/Conscia, Astec, Intech-LES, Datalab, Comtrade adjacent entities, CREA, Trilab, Optiweb-class digital agencies, and SI fintech/paytech startups.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Enumerate systematically from the GZS ZIT member catalogue and the racunalniske-novice.com /partnerji/ directory, then filter each candidate for a finance/banking vertical page before adding it to the watchlist.

coverage_gaps.description: No job-advertisement source was captured. SI job ads (Optius, MojeDelo, LinkedIn, vendor career pages) routinely name the client bank, the core platform and the technology stack — often the only public disclosure of a private bank's vendor.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add SI job boards as a standing indirect source; run keyword monitors for bank names plus platform names (Hibis, Temenos, Oracle FLEXCUBE, Finastra, Hal E-Bank, bizBox) against vendor career pages.

coverage_gaps.description: The official Slovenian public-procurement portal (Portal javnih naročil / eJN, enarocanje.si) was not directly reached — only the si.openprocurements.com aggregator. Also unreached: AJPES as the authoritative registry and annual-report source (used indirectly via bizi/companywall).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add the official eJN portal and AJPES as primary sources so aggregator data can be validated against the authoritative record, and so Banka Slovenije / state-owned financial entity tenders can be tracked at source.

coverage_gaps.description: No vendor PARTNER page (as opposed to customer reference page) was captured in this pass. Partner/technology-alliance pages are the mechanism by which a domestic integrator reveals the foreign platform behind an unnamed bank deal — the explicit rationale for this cell.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: For each vendor in the actor map, specifically locate and crawl /partnerji/, /partners/, /tehnoloski-partnerji/ pages, plus the reciprocal partner-locator directories of foreign vendors (Temenos, Finastra, Microsoft, Oracle, SAP, Backbase, ACI) filtered to Slovenia.

coverage_gaps.description: Several recorded URLs were surfaced via search-result metadata rather than fetched in this pass (Halcom support FAQ pages, hrc.si individual news article URLs, marand.si, in516ht.com, mikrografija.com/references/, gzs.si KATALOGI). Only hrc.si/si/o-nas was actually fetched.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run the deterministic liveness/verification pass over every URL in this slice; treat any 403/timeout as bot defence rather than a dead source, and re-resolve 404s by site navigation.

coverage_gaps.description: Slovenian-language search was used throughout and was decisive (Hibis/Hrc, Bankart, ZZI and the ZBS/GZS pointers were only found via sl queries). However, no Serbian/Croatian-language searching was done even though Hrc, Halcom and Comtrade all operate HR/RS units whose local sites often name clients the SI sites omit.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Extend a follow-up pass to hr/sr language variants of the same vendor domains (hrc.si/hr, halcom.com/sr_en) to harvest cross-border reference disclosures.

coverage_gaps.description: flik.si was not crawled directly in this pass; its participant list, merchant/acquirer pages and any technical documentation remain unmapped.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Crawl https://www.flik.si/ end-to-end (SL), enumerating bank listings, business/merchant pages and any rulebook or integration docs.

coverage_gaps.description: Slovenian payments-adjacent operators and vendors not covered here: Halcom (e-banking/payments software), Bankhub/Bankart competitors in acquiring, Nexi/Nets local presence, Mastercard/Visa SI country offices, and Trgovinska/POS acquirers. These sit at the boundary of the cell but were not searched.

coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Fetch and parse both pages; establish whether the operator register is a static list or a queryable register, and locate the annual payment/settlement systems report series index.

coverage_gaps.description: No archival/temporal source was established for these sites (e.g. Wayback snapshots of bankart.si service pages or flik.si participant lists), so historical change detection would start from zero.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Seed the collection with Internet Archive snapshots for bankart.si, flik.si and the BSI payment-system pages to backfill a change timeline.

coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a SL media-monitoring pass with entity queries on 'Bankart', 'Flik', 'BIPS', 'takojsnja placila' across finance.si, delo.si and IT trade outlets; note most are paywalled.

coverage_gaps.description: Crypto/e-money actors beyond Eligma/GoCrypto (e.g. Bitstamp's Slovenian origins, local exchanges and stablecoin/CASP entrants) were not enumerated from any licensed-entity list.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Locate the gov.si VASP/CASP register and the ATVP MiCA authorisation list, then cross-map to merchant-acceptance offerings.

coverage_gaps.description: No developer/integration documentation portals (API docs, plugin repos, e-commerce platform marketplaces) were captured for Slovenian PSPs and wallets, despite being public by design and highly diagnostic of capability.

coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Crawl vendor 'reference/zgodbe strank/uspešne zgodbe' sections and large-merchant newsrooms (Petrol, Mercator, Tuš, Pošta Slovenije) for the merchant-side account of integrations.

coverage_gaps.description: Core Slovenian business/financial media that most likely carry PSP deal news — Finance.si, STA, Ekipa/Svet kapitala, Poslovni dnevnik — were not confirmed as sources in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Directly probe finance.si, sta.si and rtvslo.si business sections with payments keywords and record paywall status per outlet.

coverage_gaps.description: No quantitative payment-statistics source was captured for sizing non-bank share (card/instant payment volumes by instrument).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add Banka Slovenije payment statistics and ECB Payments Statistics (SI breakdown) as structured data sources in a later pass.

coverage_gaps.description: Newsrooms not yet located for UniCredit Banka Slovenija, BKS Bank AG branch Slovenia, Banka Sparkasse, Hranilnica LON, and the SDH/SID-owned institution perimeter beyond SID banka itself.
